description_en: Queries the scheduling rules of a traffic scheduler
description_zh: 查询流量调度器的调度规则
name: DescribeSchedulerRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to return for a paged query. For example, to query the first page of results, set the value to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则填写1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

SchedulerRules.description_en: The information about the traffic scheduling rules

Param.description_en: The rules for the interaction between a Global Accelerator (GA) instance and an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
Param.description_zh: 全球加速实例联动DDoS高防的规则

CloudInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Global Accelerator (GA) instance

ParamType.description_en: The type of the resource for interaction. Valid value: GA, which indicates a Global Accelerator (GA) instance
ParamType.description_zh: 联动资源的类型。取值：GA，表示全球加速实例

RuleType.description_en:
The type of the rule. Valid values:
2: tiered protection
3: cross-border acceleration
5: CDN interaction
6: cloud service interaction
8: secure acceleration
RuleType.description_zh:
规则类型。取值：
2：阶梯防护
3：出海加速
5：CDN联动
6：云产品联动
8：安全加速

Line.description_en:
The DNS resolution line. Default value: default.

For more information, see:
<props="china">DNS resolution lines (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29807.html).</props>

<props="intl">DNS resolution lines (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29807.htm)</props>
Line.description_zh:
解析线路，默认为default。

参见：
<props="china">解析线路枚举 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29807.html)。</props>

<props="intl">解析线路枚举 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29807.htm)</props>

RegionId.description_en:
The region ID.

This parameter is returned only when the value of RuleType is 2, which indicates a tiered protection rule
RegionId.description_zh:
地域ID。

仅当RuleType（即阶梯防护规则）取值为2时返回

RestoreDelay.description_en: The waiting time of switchback, in minutes

Status.description_en:
The status of the rule. Valid values:
0: inactive
1: active
Status.description_zh:
规则生效状态。取值：
0：未生效
1：生效

Type.description_en:
The format of the resource address. Valid values:
A: IPv4 address
CNAME: CNAME
Type.description_zh:
资源地址的格式。取值：
A：IPv4地址
CNAME：CNAME地址

ValueType.description_en:
The type of the resource address. Valid values:
1: IP address of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
2: IP address of a cloud resource (tiered protection)
3: IP address of an acceleration line (cross-border acceleration)
5: accelerated domain name (CDN interaction)
6: IP address of a cloud resource (cloud service interaction)
8: secure acceleration IP
ValueType.description_zh:
资源地址类型。取值：
1：DDoS高防IP 
2：（阶梯防护）云资源IP
3：（出海加速）加速线路IP
5：（CDN联动）加速域名
6：（云产品联动）云资源IP
8：（安全加速）安全加速P

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of traffic scheduling rules
